name: 3D面部重建分析
description: 从视频中重建3D面部几何形状，以检测深度伪造中的几何不一致性。
useCase: Detecting face 篡改 through 3D geometric reconstruction and consistency 分析
mechanism: Fits a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to facial regions 跨 video frames and checks geometric consistency. Deepfakes often create faces that do not correspond to a valid 3D structure, producing impossible depth relationships, asymmetric geometry, or inconsistent 3D reconstructions 之间 frames.
source: Zhu, X. et al. (2016) - Face Alignment Across Large Poses: A 3D Solution, CVPR
algorithm: 3DMM Fitting (BFM/FLAME) + Geometric Consistency + Temporal 3D Trajectory Analysis
parameters: 模型: Basel Face Model, Fitting: iterative optimization, Parameters: 199 shape + 29 expression, Frame window: 30
strengths:
• 验证3D几何一致性
• 检测深度不一致
• 2D操作难以伪造
• 与光照分析互补
limitations:
• 计算成本高
• 精确3D重建需要高质量输入
• 极端姿态下精度降低
• 低分辨率视频受限

references.title: Zhu, X. et al. (2016). Face Alignment Across Large Poses: A 3D Solution. CVPR.
Cozzolino, D. et al. (2021). ID-Reveal: Identity-aware DeepFake Video Detection. ICCV.
Deng, Y. et al. (2019). Accurate 3D Face Reconstruction with Weakly-Supervised Learning. CVPR Workshop.
